title: Safeguard exact premixed-vial status during daily dose logging

changes.title: Prevent premature Finished status for premixed vials
changes.detail: Automatic vial depletion now requires verified same-vial dose, waste or correction evidence, rather than kit-wide balance alone. Unattributed older entries cannot retire a specific open vial.
changes.screen: Stash / Today / Log Dose / Combo Dose

changes.title: Protect open premixed vials during preparation
changes.detail: Generic Prepare Dose rollover cannot retire an active premixed vial before physical-ledger commitment; it fails closed without changing inventory.

changes.title: Validate repeated dose logging across days
changes.detail: Fictional automated browser checks cover dose, durable save/readback, reload and next-day dose at 320px and 390px in light and dark modes, including historical unattributed entries.

dataImpact: No migration, automatic reopening, historical Deadpool inventory reconciliation, correction or stock credit. Existing saved records and localStorage key peptide-tracker-html-v1 are retained. Future ordinary user-confirmed dose logs continue to write normally. Fictional DEMO remains isolated, without live writes/import/sync.
limitations: Already-finished historical Deadpool vials and unverified physical remainder remain unchanged; separate user-approved review required before any correction.
Root cause of the user's specific earlier historical event cannot be established without physical/source evidence; the safeguard is preventative.
Separate draft PRs #169 (multi-source Undo) and #173 (historical record review) are excluded.
User-reported iPhone UX acceptance 6/6; VoiceOver and real historical private-data recovery not tested.

Primary Cloudflare production passed 16/16 exact file parity at merged commit 597d262d3f631ba51da02f4d4534f0f254b6e148 (workflow #44033882596); publication-metadata parity requires subsequent verification.

history.title: Reliable premixed-blend combination doses and accurate per-vial BAC-water records

changes.title: Prevent premature empty vials when logging premixed-blend combinations
changes.detail: Combination-dose logs now debit the blend's exact physical vial ledger, retain positive source allocations and undo identity, and roll back staged inventory if source confirmation fails.

changes.title: Record confirmed BAC water on the physical vial
changes.detail: Tapping Log Reconstitution confirms the amount shown, including an unchanged default. New standard and blend vial records retain their own exact BAC water and linked preparation history.

changes.title: Safely correct historical vial preparation records
changes.detail: Finished-vial BAC amounts can be explicitly confirmed without reopening stock, changing remaining amounts or fabricating an unknown date. Kit defaults stay labelled unverified when exact historical evidence is absent.

history.dataImpact: No automatic migration, backfill, repair or overwrite of saved dose history, inventory, current protocols, or browser localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1). Future explicit Log Reconstitution actions save the chosen BAC amount on the exact vial and append linked history. Historical Deadpool records marked empty despite missing source allocations are NOT silently restored or modified. Isolated full-app DEMO uses fictional in-memory data with no live writes or sync.
